title: Chile: Pinochet's dictatorship and its end
goal: I can describe the dictatorship in Chile and how it ended, using the passive with se.

items: I can say what was done in Chile under Pinochet and how the dictatorship ended, using se.
I can say what the plebiscite of 1988 decided.
I can say who took office in March 1990 and what Pinochet remained.
I can use se with a verb to say what was banned, approved or kept.
I can use the new words for plebiscite, constitution and majority.
